answer: A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The zephyr counter is kept in mirror and wander shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 65 aliases cost 69 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
